context.transcript:
Welcome to the Fairtown Community Outdoor Farmers Market.
Our local farmers are pleased to offer you fresh local produce at affordable prices today.
Be advised that there is a silver pickup truck blocking one of the parking lot entrances.
If this is yours, please remove it now or it will be towed.
And shoppers, don't forget our exciting contest.
Enter your name in our drawing to win a $20 gift certificate good at any of our farmers' stands.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到Fairtown社区户外农贸市场。
我们当地的农民很高兴今天能为您提供价格实惠的新鲜本地农产品。
请注意，一辆银色皮卡车正在挡住一个停车场入口。
如果这是您的车，请现在移走，否则将被拖走。
还有购物者们，别忘了我们的精彩抽奖活动。
参与我们的抽奖即可赢取一张价值20美元的礼品券，可在我们任何农场摊位使用。
